<!-- Generated by codeflower-app's cmd/gendocs: do not edit. -->

Check a sealed audit folder (a clone of its GitHub repository): that every file matches SEAL.json, that audit.json's scores follow from its facts with the rubric, that targets.tsv and the report's scorecard come from this audit.json, that the report runs no code of its own and loads nothing from outside, and that every revised or disputed outcome appears in the transcript.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower audit verify [FOLDER]
```
